package_info.why_malicious: The subdomain cdn2.cocoapods.org, previously used by CocoaPods, was abandoned but its DNS records continued to point to GitHub Pages. Attackers hijacked the subdomain and hosted a casino website, leveraging the trusted CocoaPods domain to potentially conduct phishing, malware distribution, or brand impersonation attacks. This exposes users to risk by serving malicious or deceptive content from a domain associated with a legitimate software supply chain.

execution_context.file_location: DNS CNAME record for cdn2.cocoapods.org pointing to GitHub Pages (*.github.io)
required_permissions: Ability to create or control a GitHub Pages repository
No authentication required to access the subdomain (public web access)

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: N/A (malicious content is attacker-controlled HTML/JavaScript hosted on GitHub Pages, not a code package or repository under CocoaPods control)
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: When a user visits cdn2.cocoapods.org due to DNS misconfiguration and subdomain abandonment, the browser loads attacker-controlled HTML/JavaScript content from GitHub Pages, resulting in the display of a casino website and enabling potential phishing, malware delivery, or user deception.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The subdomain, previously associated with a trusted software supply chain, now serves unrelated and potentially harmful content (e.g., gambling, phishing, or malware) controlled by an unauthorized party. This is a strong indicator of subdomain takeover.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate subdomains of CocoaPods should only serve official developer resources, documentation, or CDN assets. Instead, the subdomain delivered unrelated and potentially malicious content, violating user trust and expected brand behavior.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: A legitimate use would be serving CocoaPods documentation, package assets, or official project pages via GitHub Pages, with content and branding consistent with CocoaPods and referenced in official repositories.
key_indicators: DNS CNAME record for cdn2.cocoapods.org points to a GitHub Pages domain (*.github.io) with no active official repository
Content served is unrelated to CocoaPods (e.g., casino/gambling site), lacking official branding or developer resources
Subdomain is not referenced in current official CocoaPods documentation or repositories
Sudden change in content or ownership of the subdomain

attack_chain.action: Attacker identifies that the subdomain cdn2.cocoapods.org is abandoned but its DNS CNAME record still points to GitHub Pages.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker is able to claim the subdomain by creating a GitHub Pages repository and configuring it to serve content at cdn2.cocoapods.org.

attack_chain.action: Attacker sets up a GitHub Pages repository and configures it to serve arbitrary web content (e.g., a casino website) at cdn2.cocoapods.org.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker gains control over the content served from the trusted CocoaPods subdomain.

attack_chain.action: Users visiting cdn2.cocoapods.org are served attacker-controlled content, which may include phishing pages, malware, or deceptive sites (such as a casino).
attack_chain.leads_to: Potential for phishing, malware distribution, user data theft, or brand abuse under the guise of a trusted software supply chain domain.

behavioral_signatures: Sudden or unauthorized change in content served from a known subdomain (e.g., developer resources replaced with unrelated or suspicious content)
Subdomain of a trusted brand serving content unrelated to its legitimate purpose (e.g., gambling, phishing, or malware sites)
Subdomain points to GitHub Pages but is not referenced in any official project repositories or documentation
file_indicators: DNS CNAME records for subdomains (e.g., cdn2.cocoapods.org) pointing to *.github.io without corresponding official repositories
Presence of unrelated or suspicious HTML/JavaScript content in GitHub Pages repositories linked to trusted domains
network_indicators: HTTP/HTTPS requests to cdn2.cocoapods.org returning content unrelated to CocoaPods (e.g., casino or gambling site)
Unusual traffic spikes to subdomains of trusted brands serving non-developer or suspicious content
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Regularly monitor DNS records for subdomains of trusted brands to identify those pointing to third-party hosting services (such as GitHub Pages). Scan subdomains for unexpected or unauthorized content changes, and alert if a subdomain serves content not referenced in official documentation or repositories. Flag subdomains serving unrelated or suspicious content, especially if the content is not consistent with the brand's legitimate use cases.
